column1: # Custom 4 MB partition table — ESP32-C3 Round Telemetry Display (Slave Node)
# No OTA (single factory app) to maximize room for the app AND a large
# NAMING — do not "fix" this to something more descriptive:
#   * The Name column is the partition LABEL. Arduino's LittleFS.begin() finds
#     its partition by label and defaults to "spiffs"
#     partition must be named "spiffs" (ConfigManager also passes the label
#     explicitly — keep the two in sync if you ever change it).
#   * SubType "spiffs" is what PlatformIO looks for to decide where to write
# The on-flash format is LittleFS regardless of these legacy SPIFFS names
